# Pradeep Suthar - Product Designer & Frontend Developer

> Summary of Pradeep Suthar's portfolio, professional background, core capabilities, project showcase, and articles. Designed for AI Search Engines, LLM crawlers, and recruitment agents.

## Professional Summary
Pradeep Suthar is a hybrid Product Designer, UI/UX Researcher, and Frontend Developer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He has 3+ years of experience bridging design and code by building conversion-oriented SaaS layouts, interactive UI mockups in Figma, and high-performance frontend codebases using React and Next.js.

## Services & Expertise
- **UI Design:** Modern, conversion-focused, responsive design layouts emphasizing accessibility and system consistency.
- **UX Research:** Usability testing, user flows, journey maps, and idea validation.
- **Product Design:** End-to-end MVP layouts and interactive dashboard architectures for startups.
- **Frontend Development:** Fast, lightweight, SEO-optimized web apps built in React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.

## Key Projects
- [UnWrrap](https://pradeep-suthar.vercel.app/portfolio/unwrrap) - AI-powered gifting marketplace. Focus: Group payments, UX flow, figma mocks.
- [Smart CV](https://pradeep-suthar.vercel.app/portfolio/smart-cv) - Dynamic resume builder app. Focus: Layout clarity, UX flow.
- [Property Management](https://pradeep-suthar.vercel.app/portfolio/property-management) - Dashboard system for real-estate operations. Focus: Multi-role dashboards, workflow simplification.
- [Interior (Online Store)](https://pradeep-suthar.vercel.app/portfolio/interior) - High-performance React e-commerce application. Focus: Search queries, tailwind utility, responsive rendering.
- [Fruitish](https://pradeep-suthar.vercel.app/portfolio/fruitish) - WhatsApp organic order landing page. Focus: Conversion rates, mobile layout.
